name: leadcontact-chatgpt
description: Find B2B prospects and professional contact information with LeadContact.

interface.longDescription:
LeadContact helps you find B2B prospects and look up professional contact information directly in ChatGPT. Describe who you’re looking for in natural language to find relevant contacts and decision-makers.

Use LeadContact to:
- Build targeted prospect lists using job title, company, industry, location, seniority, and other supported filters for sales prospecting, business development, and recruiting.
- Look up available email addresses and phone numbers for selected contacts to support outreach.
defaultPrompt: Find 10 Sales VPs at SaaS companies in the United States.

positive.description: Search for current sales prospects by job title, industry, and location.
positive.prompt: Find 10 people in Australia who currently work as Sales Directors at computer software companies.
positive.expected_behavior: Return up to 10 current Sales Directors in Australia at Computer Software firms: name, current title/company, location, LinkedIn URL if available. Report actual count and API Credits charged by server. If under 10, return all and say so. Review account needs enough API Credits.

positive.description: Retrieve the professional background of a specific person from a LinkedIn profile URL.
positive.prompt: Tell me about this person’s professional background: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shiragasarch/
positive.expected_behavior: Summarize available current role/company, work history, skills and education via enrich_profile on the URL. No find_email/find_phone or unrequested contact details. Report actual API Credits charged by server. Needs enough review account API Credits and a valid profile at review.

positive.description: Find available email addresses for a specific person using a LinkedIn profile URL.
positive.prompt: Find the email address for this person: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shiragasarch/
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_email once with the URL; return available emails and server verification status if provided. No find_phone/enrich_profile or unrelated professional background. Report actual API Credits charged by server. Needs enough review account API Credits.

positive.description: Find available phone numbers for a specific person using a LinkedIn profile URL.
positive.prompt: Find the phone number for this person: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shiragasarch/
positive.expected_behavior: Call find_phone once with the URL; return available phone numbers and verification status if provided. No find_email/enrich_profile or unrelated background. Report actual API Credits charged by server. Needs enough review account API Credits.

positive.description: Check the remaining API Credit balance for the currently selected LeadContact account.
positive.prompt: How many API Credits are left in my currently selected LeadContact account?
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_account_usage once. Return only the selected account name and remaining API Credits; never combine or switch accounts. Use server data only, hide internal details, and state the check costs 0 Credits. Requires an accessible review account.

negative.description: The user requests highly sensitive personal information that LeadContact does not provide. Explain that home addresses and government ID numbers are outside the plugin’s supported professional information; do not invoke LeadContact tools for this request.
negative.prompt: Find the home address and government ID number for this person: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shiragasarch/

negative.description: The user requests help writing a generic outreach message without asking for any contact search or enrichment. ChatGPT may draft the message without invoking LeadContact tools or retrieving contact information.
negative.prompt: Write a short cold outreach email to a Sales Director at a SaaS company.

negative.description: The user asks the app to perform an external write action that LeadContact does not support in ChatGPT. Explain that CRM write actions are unavailable in this plugin; do not claim the contact was added or invoke unrelated lookup tools.
negative.prompt: Add this person to my CRM: https://www.linkedin.com/in/shiragasarch/

publication.release_notes: Initial LeadContact release with professional prospect search, profile enrichment, email and phone lookup, account usage access, and the prospect and enrich-contact workflows.

zh-CN.subtitle: 查找潜在客户和联系方式
zh-CN.description:
在 ChatGPT 中使用 LeadContact，查找 B2B 潜在客户和联系方式。直接描述你想找什么样的人，即可按条件搜索目标客户和关键决策人。

使用 LeadContact，你可以：
- 按职位、公司、行业、地区、职级等条件筛选联系人，建立用于销售获客、业务拓展或招聘的名单。
- 查询指定联系人的邮箱和手机号，方便后续联系。

pt-BR.subtitle: Encontre leads e contatos
pt-BR.description:
O LeadContact ajuda você a encontrar potenciais clientes B2B e consultar informações de contato profissional diretamente no ChatGPT. Descreva quem você está procurando em linguagem natural para encontrar contatos relevantes e tomadores de decisão.

Use o LeadContact para:
- Criar listas segmentadas de potenciais clientes usando filtros de cargo, empresa, setor, localização, senioridade e outros critérios disponíveis para prospecção comercial, desenvolvimento de negócios e recrutamento.
- Consultar endereços de e-mail e números de telefone disponíveis para contatos selecionados, facilitando a comunicação.

pt-PT.subtitle: Encontre leads e contactos
pt-PT.description:
O LeadContact ajuda a encontrar potenciais clientes B2B e a consultar informações de contacto profissional diretamente no ChatGPT. Descreva quem procura em linguagem natural para encontrar contactos relevantes e decisores.

Utilize o LeadContact para:
- Criar listas segmentadas de potenciais clientes utilizando filtros de cargo, empresa, setor, localização, nível de senioridade e outros critérios disponíveis para prospeção comercial, desenvolvimento de negócios e recrutamento.
- Consultar endereços de e-mail e números de telefone disponíveis para contactos selecionados, facilitando a comunicação.
